title: Violet Fault Spire
description: A seven-metre violet blade growing with smaller intergrown crystals from a displaced limestone fissure; references: ref_07_violet_crater and ref_03_canyon_cliffs.

review.notes: Lead extra round: approved. The crystal is unchanged from round 3 (same make_crystal/crystal_material code; the diff only touches support_material and outcrop), and it already passed then. The base now uses cluster_b's approved support_material and outcrop code, identical line for line: the camouflage blotches, stretched side texture and painted black cracks are gone. The limestone is a narrow grey tone range with irregular moss on the upward faces, soil-dark AO in recesses, and fractured blocks of varied height (closeup_base, all turns). Polish, not blocking: the moss patches read slightly soft and smudged up close.
